441ab44e21378d9093d595803ac227768815e5b4.standard:
Ask: are you choking?
If they can cough forcefully, encourage coughing. Watch closely.
If they cannot speak, cough or breathe, give up to 5 back blows. Give blows between the shoulder blades. Use the heel of the hand.
If blows fail, give up to 5 abdominal thrusts. Place fist above the navel. Pull quick inward and upward.
Alternate 5 blows and 5 thrusts.
If they collapse, start CPR. Call for the crew medical officer.

If they can cough hard, tell them to keep coughing. Keep watching them.
If they cannot speak, cough or breathe, hit the back. Give up to 5 hits between the shoulder blades. Use the heel of the hand.
If back hits do not work, push on the belly. Give up to 5 pushes. Make a fist above the navel. Pull fast in and up.
Keep switching between 5 back hits and 5 belly pushes.
If they collapse, start CPR. Call for the crew medical officer.

Start compressions at once if there is no normal breathing.

Clear the person before any shock.
